entries.correctiveAction: Configure WeightedSum/Lexicographic through AggregationMode and explicit ExecutionCriteria, and test unsupported Sustainability through an explicit criterion rather than by assigning PrimaryObjectiveKind.
entries.permanentGuard: Generated tests must not assign a baseline read-only property. PrimaryObjectiveKind mutability is validated before worktree creation and assignments are rejected by payload self-audit.

entries.symptom: A generated fixture assigns a newly constructed OptimizationObjectivePolicy to SupplyChain.ObjectivePolicy before adding the native enabled criteria required by OptimizationObjectivePolicy.EnsureValid().
entries.rootCause: Fixture construction treated the parent setter as passive storage although the setter immediately validates the child object.
entries.correctiveAction: Construct the policy locally, synchronize native and alpha.33 execution criteria, call policy.EnsureValid(), and only then attach it to SupplyChain.ObjectivePolicy.
entries.permanentGuard: A child object whose parent setter invokes validation must be fully valid before attachment; generated tests may not rely on post-attachment completion.

entries.symptom: Roadmap wording 'Service' is treated as evidence for OptimizationObjectiveKind.Service even though the established Core member is OptimizationObjectiveKind.ServiceLevel.
entries.rootCause: Conceptual roadmap labels and exact public C# enum identifiers were conflated.
entries.correctiveAction: Use the established ServiceLevel member in executable-support tests and keep both Sustainability and ServiceLevel explicitly unsupported until their real criteria are implemented.
entries.permanentGuard: Roadmap vocabulary must be mapped to exact established API identifiers before code generation; ServiceLevel is the current Core identifier.

entries.symptom: A payload self-audit rejects OptimizationObjectiveKind.ServiceLevel because it searches for the prefix string OptimizationObjectiveKind.Service.
entries.rootCause: The guard used substring matching for a C# identifier instead of exact token matching.
entries.correctiveAction: Use identifier-boundary-aware regex matching and self-test both the forbidden exact token and a valid prefixed identifier before scanning the payload.
entries.permanentGuard: Lexical guards for C# identifiers must match complete tokens, never prefixes; every such guard must include a positive and negative self-test.

entries.symptom: A preflight rejects a valid baseline because it searches for the exact text of a runtime validation exception inside source code.
entries.rootCause: A demonstrated behavioral invariant was encoded as a brittle message-literal source contract.
entries.correctiveAction: Validate structural API evidence instead: policy declaration, EnsureValid contract, native criterion declaration and policy-to-criterion structural reference.
entries.permanentGuard: Behavioral contracts must not be validated by exact exception-message text unless the message itself is the public contract.

entries.symptom: New feature tests compile but a fixture/runtime integration defect is discovered only after the full canonical validation pipeline.
entries.rootCause: The candidate had no focused execution gate for the tests introduced by the milestone before broad validation.
entries.correctiveAction: Execute MultiObjectiveFinancialExecutionTests immediately after candidate commit and before the full warnings-as-errors dependency closure.
entries.permanentGuard: Every milestone introducing nontrivial runtime tests must execute a focused new-feature smoke gate before broad Build-Validated.

entries.symptom: A test intended to verify an unsupported objective never reaches the objective planner because its WeightedSum policy contains only one enabled criterion and is rejected by the native Core policy validator.
entries.rootCause: The fixture satisfied the downstream test intent but violated the upstream aggregation invariant required for a valid WeightedSum policy.
entries.correctiveAction: Construct unsupported-objective tests with the unsupported criterion plus an Economic control criterion, and enforce at least two execution criteria in the canonical WeightedSum fixture helper.
entries.permanentGuard: A fixture testing downstream behavior must first satisfy every upstream Core invariant. Generated WeightedSum fixtures require at least two criteria before native policy construction.

entries.symptom: An external algorithm bridge restores an unpinned or mutable dependency.
entries.rootCause: Library version identity was treated as sufficient reproducibility evidence.
entries.correctiveAction: Pin ULSAlgorithms 1.1.0, its source commit and exact release-package SHA-256; vendor the verified nupkg.
entries.permanentGuard: External algorithm dependencies require version, source commit and immutable artifact hash before candidate creation.

entries.symptom: An adapter guesses an algorithm name or activates a method merely because it appears related to ULS.
entries.rootCause: Roadmap labels were substituted for canonical external catalog identifiers.
entries.correctiveAction: Use only wagner-whitin-classical and zangwill-network from the ULSAlgorithms v1.1.0 catalog and verify UlsSolverKind.Exact.
entries.permanentGuard: Every external method ID must come from the pinned public catalog and its exact/heuristic kind must be checked at runtime.

entries.symptom: A requested exact method is unavailable or inapplicable and another algorithm runs silently.
entries.rootCause: Method selection was conflated with fallback-oriented backend selection.
entries.correctiveAction: Alpha.34 maps one explicit enum value to one immutable external solver ID; unsupported values fail.
entries.permanentGuard: Exact-method adapters execute the requested algorithm or fail; no automatic method fallback is permitted.

entries.symptom: A specialized ULS algorithm is applied to a richer capacitated, multi-item, scheduling or network instance.
entries.rootCause: Applicability was inferred from a broad class label without checking the executable mathematical shape.
entries.correctiveAction: Require the narrow canonical SI-ULS instance/model structure and reject every unexpected decision category or constraint family.
entries.permanentGuard: Specialized adapters validate their complete mathematical applicability contract before calling the external method.

entries.symptom: An external solution is projected despite missing periods, inconsistent objective value or failed feasibility validation.
entries.rootCause: Successful external return was treated as sufficient normalized-solution evidence.
entries.correctiveAction: Require complete horizon vectors, UlsSolutionValidator feasibility and objective parity before projection.
entries.permanentGuard: External solver output is untrusted until independently validated and complete.

entries.symptom: External-package/catalog/runtime integration fails only during the complete validation campaign.
entries.rootCause: No focused gate exercised the newly introduced exact adapters first.
entries.correctiveAction: Run UlsAlgorithmsExactAdapterTests immediately after candidate commit and before broad warnings-as-errors validation.
entries.permanentGuard: Every external adapter milestone has a focused runtime smoke before Build-Validated.

entries.symptom: A transitive restore reports NU1101 for a vendored package even though the package file exists in the solver project tree.
entries.rootCause: RestoreAdditionalProjectSources was declared only in the package-consuming project and was not visible to the complete restore graph started from another project.
entries.correctiveAction: Declare the vendored source in repository-root NuGet.Config so every project restored under the repository sees the same source.
entries.permanentGuard: A vendored PackageReference must have repository-level restore-source visibility and must be exercised from a transitive test-project restore.

entries.symptom: A verified vendored nupkg exists in the worktree but disappears from the committed candidate.
entries.rootCause: The repository-wide Visual Studio .gitignore contains *.nupkg.
entries.correctiveAction: Force-add the exact verified ULSAlgorithms.1.1.0.nupkg and assert that git ls-files --stage contains it before committing.
entries.permanentGuard: Every intentionally vendored artifact ignored by a generic pattern must be explicitly force-added and staged-verified.

entries.symptom: Only a convenient subset of a pinned external heuristic catalog is adapted while the milestone is presented as ULS heuristic support.
entries.rootCause: Heuristic support was enumerated informally instead of checked against the immutable external runtime catalog.
entries.correctiveAction: Pin all 19 public ULSAlgorithms v1.1.0 heuristic IDs and require exact runtime catalog parity before execution.
entries.permanentGuard: A catalog-wide heuristic milestone must prove complete pinned ID parity; silent omissions and silent additions are forbidden.

entries.symptom: A feasible heuristic result is projected through the same optimality semantics as an exact method.
entries.rootCause: Common IUlsSolver mechanics obscured the scientific distinction between feasible construction and optimality proof.
entries.correctiveAction: Require UlsSolveStatus.Feasible and project HasFeasibleSolution=true, IsOptimal=false, with no fabricated bound or gap.
entries.permanentGuard: Heuristic adapters never assert optimality, best bounds or optimality gaps.

entries.symptom: A heuristic-returned plan is normalized without an independent feasibility check.
entries.rootCause: Heuristic completion was treated as feasibility evidence.
entries.correctiveAction: Run UlsSolutionValidator.Validate and require complete horizon vectors and objective parity before projection.
entries.permanentGuard: Every external heuristic result is untrusted until independently validated.

entries.symptom: A heuristic integration reports an objective lower than a proven exact optimum because of cost or projection inconsistency.
entries.rootCause: No cross-method scientific sanity check linked heuristic costs to the exact baseline.
entries.correctiveAction: On a common compatible smoke instance, compare every pinned heuristic objective against Wagner-Whitin exact and reject any value below the optimum beyond tolerance.
entries.permanentGuard: Catalog-wide heuristic smoke includes an exact-optimum lower-bound sanity check.

entries.symptom: Heuristic adapters accept richer LotSizingDataModel instances than the exact bridge without a new scientific applicability proof.
entries.rootCause: Algorithm family expansion was confused with problem-class expansion.
entries.correctiveAction: Reuse the strict alpha.34 canonical SI-ULS extractor for alpha.35.
entries.permanentGuard: Adding methods does not broaden the accepted problem class unless a dedicated applicability milestone proves it.

entries.symptom: A later adapter milestone silently reacquires or replaces the external library already frozen by a validated baseline.
entries.rootCause: Dependency acquisition was repeated instead of treated as baseline evidence.
entries.correctiveAction: Alpha.35 verifies the already tracked ULSAlgorithms v1.1.0 package, hash, PackageReference and root NuGet.Config without replacing them.
entries.permanentGuard: Validated vendored dependencies are inherited and verified; they are not reacquired unless the milestone explicitly upgrades them.

entries.symptom: One of many public heuristics fails catalog creation, applicability or feasibility only during the full validation campaign.
entries.rootCause: No focused catalog-wide heuristic gate ran before broad validation.
entries.correctiveAction: Run UlsAlgorithmsHeuristicAdapterTests immediately after candidate commit and before the warnings-as-errors closure.
entries.permanentGuard: Catalog-wide adapter milestones execute every pinned strategy in a focused runtime smoke before Build-Validated.

entries.symptom: The generic data/model project depends on an algorithm project that is intended to be built later on top of it.
entries.rootCause: Roadmap integration wording was interpreted as a dependency from the foundational model toward a downstream algorithm platform.
entries.correctiveAction: Keep alpha.36 generic and dependency-free; downstream algorithm projects consume LotSizingDataModel instead.
entries.permanentGuard: LotSizingDataModel must not introduce references, packages or namespaces belonging to downstream algorithm projects.

entries.symptom: A Lagrangian multiplier sign is chosen without a single residual convention, invalidating dual-bound semantics.
entries.rootCause: Constraint sense and multiplier domain were treated independently.
entries.correctiveAction: Use residual lhs-rhs and enforce lambda>=0 for <=, lambda<=0 for >=, and free lambda for equality in minimization models.
entries.permanentGuard: Every relaxed minimization constraint must pass explicit multiplier-domain validation before model transformation.

entries.symptom: Building a relaxation mutates or removes constraints from the original mathematical model.
entries.rootCause: Relaxation transformation was applied in place.
entries.correctiveAction: Clone the MathematicalModel, disable selected constraints only in the clone, and add lambda*(lhs-rhs) to the cloned objective.
entries.permanentGuard: Generic relaxation builders are source-preserving transformations.

entries.symptom: A relaxed objective adds lambda*lhs but omits the -lambda*rhs constant.
entries.rootCause: Only variable coefficients were considered during transformation.
entries.correctiveAction: Relax the complete residual lhs-rhs, including its objective constant contribution.
entries.permanentGuard: Lagrangian objective construction must preserve both residual terms and constants exactly.

entries.symptom: A subgradient update moves a multiplier outside the domain required by weak duality.
entries.rootCause: Dual ascent was implemented without projection.
entries.correctiveAction: Update lambda+step*residual then project onto the exact domain implied by the constraint sense.
entries.permanentGuard: Every generic subgradient update is domain-projected and rejects negative or non-finite step sizes.

entries.symptom: A Lagrangian dual value and a primal feasible value are stored without preserving their lower-bound/upper-bound roles.
entries.rootCause: Objective values were treated as interchangeable incumbent values.
entries.correctiveAction: Track best dual lower bound and best primal upper bound separately and reject weak-duality inversions beyond tolerance.
entries.permanentGuard: Minimization LR infrastructure never labels a dual value as an upper bound or a primal feasible value as a lower bound.

entries.symptom: A minimization multiplier convention is silently reused for a maximization model.
entries.rootCause: Objective direction was not part of the applicability contract.
entries.correctiveAction: Alpha.36 explicitly rejects non-minimization models.
entries.permanentGuard: A new objective direction requires a dedicated proven sign convention and tests before support is enabled.

entries.symptom: A generic relaxation sign, constant or projection defect reaches the complete validation campaign.
entries.rootCause: No focused mathematical transformation gate was executed first.
entries.correctiveAction: Run LagrangianRelaxationFoundationTests immediately after candidate commit.
entries.permanentGuard: Generic mathematical-infrastructure milestones execute focused algebraic/runtime tests before Build-Validated.

entries.symptom: A generated test passes a nullable double directly to Assert.Equal(expected, actual, precision), causing overload resolution to select an incompatible comparer signature.
entries.rootCause: Numeric precision assertions were generated from semantic intent without checking the compile-time nullability of the actual expression.
entries.correctiveAction: Assert HasValue first, then compare the non-nullable .Value with the precision overload.
entries.permanentGuard: Generated numeric xUnit precision assertions must never target nullable numeric expressions directly.
